278.translation_description: Molto bene. Potrei chiedervi dei rimedi per gli occhi stanchi?

279.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_120
279.description: Eye drops would suffice, as would items that improve circulation. Foodstuffs purported to improve visual acuity would be welcome, too.
279.translation_description: Basterebbe del collirio, oppure qualcosa che migliori la circolazione. Sarebbero graditi anche alimenti che, a quanto si dice, migliorano la vista.

280.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_GRONDILVET_003_121
280.description: If it may aid in the preservation or enhancement of eyesight, my team and I would welcome whatever you can provide.
280.translation_description: Se può contribuire a preservare o migliorare la vista, io e la mia squadra accetteremo volentieri qualsiasi cosa.

281.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_122
281.description: Ahhh, I <hex:021A020203>see<hex:021A020103>! Been burning the midnight oil, have we? A man after my own heart.
281.translation_description: Ah, <hex:021A020203>vedo<hex:021A020103>! Hai fatto le ore piccole, eh? Uno che se ne intende!

282.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_LCUT_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_123
282.description: Well then, my gleaning genius! Let's find this hard worker respite for his tired eyes, shall we?
282.translation_description: Allora, mio genio della raccolta! Troviamo un po' di sollievo per i suoi occhi stanchi, d'accordo?

283.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_000_000
283.description: Margrat is pleased with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Kind Collaborator<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
283.translation_description: Margrat è soddisfatta del tuo impegno. Ora ti considera un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Collaboratore Gentile<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

284.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_000_001
284.description: Margrat is delighted with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Facilitator of Feline Felicity<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
284.translation_description: Margrat è entusiasta del tuo impegno. Ora ti considera un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Artefice della Felicità Felina<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

285.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_000_002
285.description: Margrat is overjoyed with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gracious Gleaner<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
285.translation_description: Margrat è felicissima del tuo impegno. Ora ti considera un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Raccoglitore Generoso<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

286.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_000_003
286.description: Margrat could not be happier with your efforts. She now considers you an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Irreplaceable Comrade<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
286.translation_description: Margrat non potrebbe essere più soddisfatta del tuo impegno. Ora ti considera un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Compagno Insostituibile<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

287.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_001_001
287.description: And yet, there is still much work to be done if the researchers of Sharlayan Hamlet are to have their myriad needs met. To that end, Margrat has a new favor to ask of you...
287.translation_description: Eppure c'è ancora molto lavoro da fare prima che i ricercatori del Borgo di Sharlayan vedano soddisfatte le loro innumerevoli necessità. Per questo Margrat vorrebbe chiederti un altro favore...

288.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUPINFO_001_002
288.description: Through your efforts, many dedicated intellectuals have found comfort and respite. It seems, however, that Margrat has something on her mind...
288.translation_description: Grazie al tuo impegno, molti studiosi instancabili hanno trovato conforto e ristoro. Sembra però che Margrat abbia qualcosa per la testa...

289.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_AFTRANKUP_000_001
289.description: The Custom Deliveries list for Margrat has been updated. To view the new list, speak with Margrat and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
289.translation_description: L'elenco delle Consegne su Misura di Margrat è stato aggiornato. Per vedere la nuova lista, parlale e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fai una consegna<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

290.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_AFTRANKUP_001_001
290.description: A new quest continuing the story of Margrat's work in Sharlayan Hamlet is now available. Upon its completion, the Custom Deliveries list for Margrat will be updated.
290.translation_description: È disponibile una nuova missione che prosegue la storia del lavoro di Margrat nel Borgo di Sharlayan. Una volta completata, l'elenco delle Consegne su Misura di Margrat verrà aggiornato.

291.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_000
291.description: ...Hm? Why have I not returned to my lab and my other neglected responsibilities?
291.translation_description: ...Eh? Perché non sono tornata al laboratorio e alle altre mie responsabilità trascurate?

292.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_001_001
292.description: Never you fear; I'll tend to the perpetual bin fires just as soon as you leave. ...You're in no hurry to go, right?
292.translation_description: Non temere: penserò io alle continue emergenze del laboratorio appena te ne andrai. ...Non hai fretta di andartene, vero?

293.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_000
293.description: I respect your dedication, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Hand-delivering commissions on time and with a smile...now that's service.
293.translation_description: Ammiro la tua dedizione, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Consegnare gli ordini di persona, in orario e col sorriso... questo sì che è servizio!

294.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_002_001
294.description: Despite what others may whisper (and occasionally declare loudly within earshot), I too strive for punctuality! And were it not for the bastar─er, <hex:021A020203>management<hex:021A020103> stipulating such...<hex:021A020203>aggressive<hex:021A020103> deadlines, I might well have time for a smile or two!
294.translation_description: Nonostante quel che mormorano gli altri (e a volte dichiarano a gran voce davanti a me), anch'io cerco di essere puntuale! E se quei bast... ehm, se la <hex:021A020203>dirigenza<hex:021A020103> non imponesse scadenze così <hex:021A020203>aggressive<hex:021A020103>, forse avrei il tempo di sorridere!

295.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_000
295.description: Excellent, this should do us quite nicely. ...I take it you'll be going, then?
295.translation_description: Ottimo, dovrebbe andare benissimo. ...Immagino che ora andrai, vero?

296.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_003_001
296.description: You could always stay awhile longer, you know! There's no need to rush─we could chat! Please? Everyone else is so busy and Hodge is no fun at all! ...<hex:021A020203>Please<hex:021A020103>?
296.translation_description: Potresti anche fermarti ancora un po', sai? Non c'è fretta: possiamo fare due chiacchiere! Ti prego! Tutti gli altri sono così impegnati e Hodge non è affatto divertente! ...Ti <hex:021A020203>prego<hex:021A020103>?

297.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_000
297.description: Thanks to your tireless efforts, our quality of life here in Sharlayan Hamlet has been drastically improved.
297.translation_description: Grazie al tuo impegno instancabile, la qualità della vita qui al Borgo di Sharlayan è migliorata enormemente.

298.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_001
298.description: Wouldn't you agree, Hodge? I'm sure <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> here has also spared you a modicum of grief.
298.translation_description: Non trovi, Hodge? Sono certa che anche <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, qui presente, ti abbia risparmiato qualche grattacapo.

299.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_004_002
299.description: ...If you wish to spare me grief, you might refrain from causing it in the first place.
299.translation_description: ...Se vuoi risparmiarmi dei grattacapi, potresti evitare di crearmeli.

300.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_003
300.description: Oh, that Hodge. He plays coy, but there's no denying that you have done much and more to ease Thesauros's burdens.
300.translation_description: Oh, quel Hodge. Fa il vago, ma non si può negare che tu abbia fatto molto per alleviare il peso sulle spalle di Thesauros.

301.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_004_004
301.description: Mark my words: if we keep peddling your services, one day Hodge will leap over his desk and wring your hand in tearful gratitude! Or perhaps just offer a genuine word of thanks!
301.translation_description: Te lo dico io: se continuiamo a promuovere i tuoi servizi, un giorno Hodge salterà oltre la scrivania e ti stringerà forte la mano, piangendo di gratitudine! O magari ti rivolgerà una parola davvero gentile!

302.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_005_000
302.description: Hodge! Have I mentioned in the past bell just how much <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> here has single-handedly improved the state of Labyrinthos with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> contributions?
302.translation_description: Hodge! Ti ho mai detto nell'ultima campana quanto <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> abbia migliorato da sé la situazione di Labyrinthos grazie ai <hex:02080FE905FF0573756F69FF0573756F6903> contributi?

303.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_005_001
303.description: Roaring Spring and Ibuki and Grondilvet and all their teams─and a great number of other researchers besides─have showered <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> with a veritable deluge of praise.
303.translation_description: Roaring Spring, Ibuki, Grondilvet, tutte le loro squadre e molti altri ricercatori hanno ricoperto <hex:02080DE905FF046C6569FF046C756903> di una vera e propria valanga di lodi.

304.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_005_002
304.description: Now it's your turn! One word, just one <hex:021A020203>tiny<hex:021A020103> little word of appreciation on behalf of Thesauros! Let's hear it!
304.translation_description: Ora tocca a te! Una sola parola, una <hex:021A020203>piccola<hex:021A020103> parola di ringraziamento a nome di Thesauros! Sentiamo!

305.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_005_003
305.description: ...I process requests. I do not issue public statements.
305.translation_description: ...Elaboro le richieste. Non rilascio dichiarazioni pubbliche.

306.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_005_004
306.description: ...It may not seem like it, but we're making progress! We'll coax a heartfelt expression of gratitude from him yet!
306.translation_description: ...Forse non si direbbe, ma stiamo facendo progressi! Riusciremo a strappargli un sentito ringraziamento, prima o poi!

307.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_005_005
307.description: Trust me, I've been bothering Hodge for years now; he's like an old, musty tome I've read cover to cover a dozen times. I see all the subtleties between the lines. So let's keep up the good work, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!
307.translation_description: Fidati, tormento Hodge da anni: è come un vecchio tomo ammuffito che ho letto da cima a fondo una dozzina di volte. Ormai colgo ogni sfumatura tra le righe. Quindi continuiamo così, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

309.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_006_001
309.description: According to Theopauldin, we've seen significantly increased returns from each and every laboratory here in Labyrinthos.
309.translation_description: Secondo Theopauldin, in tutti i laboratori di Labyrinthos i risultati sono aumentati notevolmente.

310.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_006_002
310.description: An external assessment might conclude that the projects we began in the wake of the Final Days have simply begun to yield results. That our labors were bound to bear fruit eventually. But we all know better.
310.translation_description: Una valutazione esterna potrebbe concludere che i progetti avviati dopo gli Ultimi Giorni hanno semplicemente cominciato a dare i loro frutti, e che il nostro lavoro fosse destinato a produrre risultati prima o poi. Ma noi sappiamo che non è così.

311.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_006_003
311.description: We know that our increased productivity─not to mention sunny morale─is largely thanks to you, my industrious friend.
311.translation_description: Sappiamo che l'aumento della produttività — per non parlare del morale alle stelle — è in gran parte merito tuo, mio instancabile amico.

312.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_006_004
312.description: Which means that Hodge is now <hex:021A020203>obligated<hex:021A020103> to say something nice, if only out of basic decency!
312.translation_description: Il che significa che ora Hodge è <hex:021A020203>tenuto<hex:021A020103> a dire qualcosa di gentile, fosse anche solo per decenza!

313.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_006_005
313.description: ...The gratitude I must express is threefold.
313.translation_description: ...Il mio ringraziamento si articola in tre punti.

314.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_006_006
314.description: First, for the safe return of you and your fellow Scions to the star.
314.translation_description: Primo: il ritorno sano e salvo tuo e degli altri Eredi alla stella.

315.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_006_007
315.description: Second, for the procurement of resources that Thesauros has been reluctant to provide. And third, for your social and moral support of the researchers here.
315.translation_description: Secondo: per aver procurato le risorse che Thesauros era riluttante a fornirci. Terzo: per il tuo sostegno sociale e morale ai ricercatori qui presenti.

316.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_HODGE_006_008
316.description: ...It warms my heart to see them happy.

317.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_RANKUP_MARGRAT_006_009
317.description: Hodge, you─! H-How dare you force me to weep tears of gratitude in your s-stead, you sneak! You c-crafty gil-pincher! You emotional capitalist! <sob>
317.translation_description: Hodge, tu...! C-Come osi costringermi a versare lacrime di gratitudine al tuo p-posto, furfante! Astuto arraffagil! Capitalista sentimentale! <sob>

318.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_AFTWEEKLY_000_000
318.description: You have delivered the weekly maximum of six items to Margrat. You may begin making deliveries again starting <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).
318.translation_description: Hai consegnato a Margrat il massimo settimanale di sei oggetti. Potrai ricominciare a fare consegne da <hex:020603120303><hex:020947DDFF09646F6D656E696361FF086C756E6564C3ACFF096D6172746564C3ACFF0B6D6572636F6C6564C3ACFF0967696F766564C3ACFF0976656E657264C3ACFF0773616261746F03> alle <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (ora terrestre).

319.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_MARGRAT_000_000
319.description: Who's next to storm the gates, I wonder?
319.translation_description: Chissà chi sarà il prossimo a fare irruzione, mi chiedo...

320.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER10_00842_QUEST_SYSTEM_000_002
320.description: In order to undertake the next quest, speak with Margrat as a Disciple of the Hand or the Land.
320.translation_description: Per intraprendere la missione successiva, parla con Margrat nei panni di un Discepolo della Mano o della Terra.
